blocks.text: Decision needed by Aug 29 to lock Q1 capacity.

cards.notes: Lead with the ask. Payback math is on c7 if challenged.

blocks.text: Both misses trace to the same upstream chip allocation; neither expects recovery before December.

cards.title: We need sign-off before the August 29 vendor deadline

blocks.text: Hanwei's capacity window closes Aug 29; after that, recovery slips a full quarter.
Approval today keeps January crossover on the table. A two-week slip moves it to March.

cards.notes: Close by restating the single decision on the table.
